'''Dafyd''' was a [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Ereesus Planetary Security Forces]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was involved in a [[Battle of Ereesus|battle]] to repel the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to [[Ereesus]].
